description: Hi! I'm Sithumini, a Software Engineering undergraduate passionate about web development, AI, data visualization, and creative technology. For NASA Space Apps, I'm exploring the Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map challenge and looking for curious, creative teammates interested in space science, NASA data, GIS/mapping, UI/UX, AI/ML, or presentations. You don't need to be an expert—just bring your ideas, skills, and enthusiasm to collaborate and build something meaningful.
